home_meta_title: Utsuwa: Open-Source AI Companion with 3D VRM Avatars
home_meta_description: Open-source AI companion with 3D VRM avatars, voice chat, semantic memory, and support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local LLMs. Desktop app and web. Self-hosted, privacy-first.
home_meta_description_short: Open-source AI companion with 3D VRM avatars, voice chat, semantic memory, and support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local LLMs.
hero_title_full: Give your AI a body, a voice, a memory, and a home.
hero_lede: Utsuwa is a free, open-source AI companion with a 3D VRM avatar, voice chat, and memory that lasts. Bring your own keys or run it fully offline.
letter_title: We built the body. You decide what fills it.
letter_body: Most AI lives in a text box and forgets you by morning. Utsuwa gives yours a face, a voice, and a memory, on your own keys or fully offline, with nothing routed through us.
mark_note: 器, utsuwa: a vessel. Traditionally read as four containers with a dog keeping watch.
sc_presence_title: Not a chat window. Someone in the room.
sc_presence_sub: Load any VRM avatar and they breathe, look around, and answer out loud with lip-synced voice. Replies float up as speech bubbles that follow them as they move.
sc_presence_alt: Tsuki, a 3D VRM companion, sitting on a wooden stool
sc_memory_sub: Your people, your plans, the little things you only mention once. Local embeddings weave every chat into memories they recall by meaning, and your bond grows across eight stages, from Stranger to Soulmate.
sc_own_title: Free, open source, and entirely yours
features_title: Made to play with, not just talk to
feature_custom_body: Drop in any VRM from VRoid Hub or Booth, or start with Tsuki, Yuki, or Momo.
feature_custom_alt: Momo, Tsuki, and Yuki, three 3D VRM companions, posing together around a stool
feature_ar_body: Stand them on your real floor through the camera in Android Chrome or any WebXR headset, and keep chatting the whole time.
feature_ar_alt: A phone showing a VRM companion standing in a real hallway through the camera
feature_photo_body: Pick a pose, frame the shot, drop in stickers, and save it. Your camera roll is about to get cuter.
stories_title: Built in the open, one post at a time
cta_alt: Tsuki waving with both hands, with a dark-haired companion in a high-collared jacket standing beside her, arms crossed
footer_copyright: © 2026 Juice Boxx Games LLC. Open source under AGPL-3.0.
sc_own_sub: Bring your own keys for any provider, or run the model, the voice, and the memory fully offline. Nothing is routed through us, and the code is open under AGPL-3.0.
hero_video_alt: Utsuwa running on a laptop, a wall-mounted screen, and a phone
adv_tools_body: Connect MCP servers and your companion calls them mid-conversation: check a Home Assistant sensor, search the web, look up a repo. Ask before running is on by default.
adv_tools_user: Is the living room warm enough?
adv_memory_body: Facts become a graph of your people, plans, and interests. On-device embeddings find them by meaning, so nothing leaves your machine to be searched.
adv_stages_body: Eight relationship stages, from Stranger to Soulmate. Trust and affection move with every conversation, and they can move back too.
adv_local_body: Run the model with Ollama or LM Studio, speak with a local voice, and transcribe on your own machine. No keys, no cloud.
adv_remind_body: Ask in chat and your companion schedules it, then brings it up when it is due. Open and missed reminders live under the bell.
adv_remind_user: remind me in 10 minutes to stretch
adv_overlay_body: A transparent companion that floats over any app. Ctrl+Shift+U shows or hides them, and Ctrl+Shift+Space is push-to-talk from anywhere.
